Can you play Bribes on a vote you are calling that will pass with a
Cryptic/Malk Rider Clause? Can't see any reason why no but thought it
was worth checking :-)

If so, is the vote phase skipped in this case so that only the acting
Meth can gain pool?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Timlagor wrote:
> Can you play Bribes on a vote you are calling that will pass with a
> Cryptic/Malk Rider Clause? Can't see any reason why no but thought it
> was worth checking :-)

No. Most "during a referendum" effects cannot be played on auto-pass
referendums.

From the online rulings:
Cryptic Rider:
No voting occurs during the automatic referendum, and most "during a
political action" effects cannot be used. Any effects that operate on the
number of votes that the referendum passed by have no effect. [LSJ 19980107]

>call? (as opposed to lining up and triggering on successive referenda

All Malkavian Rider Clauses in play are burned on the first political
action called by the controller of the card.

Pertinent card text: "the next referendum".
No delay allowed.
